desc: Derive formula: max kept = 1 + max_{d>=2} d * max_c count of neighbors of c with degree >= d.
Implement the O(N) global descending degree sweep in Python with fast I/O, bucketing by degree, and output N - best.
Verify the implementation on samples and edge cases (N=3 path, star, paths, high-degree) and ensure no off-by-one (d = y+1, degree >= d).
